environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster, pod running in namespace 'observability' with default Istio sidecar injection. No Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied. Pod runs with default service account. Other pods in namespace 'default' and 'attacker-ns' can freely send gRPC/HTTP traffic to the health-monitor pod on port 50051 and port 8080. No NetworkPolicy restricts cross-namespace traffic. The attacker pod can send rapid SIGTERM signals via shared PID namespace (hostPID: true in attacker deployment) or exploit the race by timing requests during credential rotation window.
